subject: Stonebridge CAIQ sync: availability, annotated Q&A, and evidence owners
messages:
From: Eli Navarro <eli.navarro@stonebridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example>
Cc: security@stonebridge.com
Date: 2027-06-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ kickoff & a couple of prep questions

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking this — we want to schedule a CAIQ walkthrough and hand off any required evidence. A few quick items before we lock time:

- Our security team is primarily available Wed/Thu mornings PST for a 45–60 minute sync. Can you share 3 windows?
- We saw a short list of control exceptions in the Sig/CAIQ binder; can you point us to the single-page evidence matrix that maps Redwood owners to artifacts?
- We’ll need an export of your access logging retention policy (dates/locations) and a sample audit log (redacted is fine). Can that be prepared prior to the call?

Attachment: "stonebridge_request_summary.pdf" (sample template from our GRC)

Eli Navarro
Senior Security Program Manager
Stonebridge Systems
eli.navarro@stonebridge.com
Security team: security@stonebridge.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example>
To: Eli Navarro <eli.navarro@stonebridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.example>
Date: 2027-06-12T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ kickoff & a couple of prep questions

Eli — thanks for the clear asks. We can do this. Quick responses inline and proposed slots below.

1) Availability: Wed/Thu mornings PST — we can do:
   - Wed 2027-06-16 09:30–10:30 PT
   - Wed 2027-06-16 11:00–12:00 PT (if you need extra time)
   - Thu 2027-06-17 09:00–10:00 PT

2) Evidence matrix: attaching our working "redwood_evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx" — it's a one-sheet mapping of CAIQ sections to owners and sample files. We'll mark owners and expected delivery dates.

3) Access logging & sample: Olga will own the log export. Olga — can you produce a redacted sample audit log and the policy summary (retention by region) by EOD Tuesday (6/15)? If you need a different timeline, propose it.

Attachments: redwood_evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx (current draft), prep-agenda-CAIQ.txt

Next steps:
- Eli: confirm which slot you prefer and whether 60 minutes is required.
- Stonebridge: if you have any targeted CAIQ sections to prioritize (networking, auth, data residency, logging), flag them and we’ll surface artifacts first.

Cheers,

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.example
+1 (415) 555-0184

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.example>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>
Cc: Eli Navarro <eli.navarro@stonebridge.com>, security@stonebridge.com
Date: 2027-06-13T07:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ kickoff & a couple of prep questions

Ben / Marissa / Eli — confirming I’ll take the log artifacts. Planned deliverables and ETA: 

- redwood_logging_policy_summary.pdf — describes retention windows by region (US/EU/APAC) — ETA: 2027-06-15 17:00 PT
- sample_audit_log_redacted.csv — contains two days of redacted event lines (IPs truncated, user IDs hashed) — ETA: 2027-06-15 17:00 PT
- notes on our PKI access controls and where logs are stored (S3 bucket path and retention lifecycle) — included in the summary PDF.

If Stonebridge needs CSV in a specific schema, let me know; otherwise I’ll use the standard sample we deliver for SOC2/CAIQ calls.

Also, Ben: I updated the evidence matrix with a few owners and status flags. I set the initial delivery column to 2027-06-15 for logs and 2027-06-18 for a few longer artifacts (config snapshots).

Attachments: (internal) "redwood_evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx" (updated), "olga_log_sample_spec.txt"

Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.example

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example>
To: Eli Navarro <eli.navarro@stonebridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.example>, security@stonebridge.com
Date: 2027-06-14T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ kickoff & a couple of prep questions — meeting notes and action log

Eli / team — thanks for joining the 60-minute sync today. Quick notes, decisions, and action owners so nothing gets lost. (Recording and slides uploaded to the Drive link below.)

Meeting summary (2027-06-14 10:00 PT):
- Scope: CAIQ sections prioritized — Authentication & Identity, Logging & Monitoring, Data Residency. Stonebridge asked for more detail on request-level KV cache behavior; we captured examples.
- Delivery commitments:
   - Olga: redacted sample audit log + logging policy summary — delivered as promised (see attachment sample_audit_log_redacted.csv).
   - Marissa: config snapshot for RBAC & SSO integrations — ETA 2027-06-18.
   - Ben: walk-through of model hosting isolation and dedicated capacity controls — added to evidence matrix under Section 6.

Open Q&A highlights (annotated):
- Q: How long is KV cache retained and where does it live?
  A: Short-lived in-memory KV with an eviction policy; persistent logs (operation metadata) go to our encrypted object store. See matrix notes under Logging -> Evidence file: "kv-cache-ops.txt".
- Q: Can you provide a sample of customer-level audit trail for a single request?
  A: We provided a redacted sample; Stonesbridge to review and confirm sufficiency for their audit.

Attachments delivered in thread: redwood_evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx, meeting-notes-20270614.txt, sample_audit_log_redacted.csv

Action items:
- Stonebridge (Eli): confirm whether the provided redacted log satisfies the audit scope — due 2027-06-21.
- Olga: follow up with SRE to extract a 30-day config-change delta (if Stonebridge requests) — ETA 2027-06-18.
- Marissa: upload RBAC config snapshot and SSO metadata — ETA 2027-06-18.

Links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSB-CAIQ
- HubSpot record: HS-7854123

If any of the owners above need to change dates, reply-all with updated ETA and reason. Thanks again — we’ll stand by for Eli’s confirmation on the audit log.

Best,

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.example
+1 (415) 555-0184
